summary: Host-neutral semantic Asset SDK built on the shared-types ProjectAsset and Resource contracts.
context_hints: Do not duplicate Asset shapes here; import the canonical schemas and types from @clash/shared-types
Adapters own Project Loro, Global library state, registries, storage and URL projection; this package owns semantic orchestration and validation

The browser-safe Project and personal Global Asset HTTP clients own route construction, auth headers, multipart import and response validation; the Project client additionally owns read receipts. Consumers may add Host discovery or UI caching but must not reimplement the transport

Project multipart imports are at-least-once commands: the HTTP client snapshots the first command object and assigns its stable Project Asset id before I/O. Retrying that object replays the snapshot; a different object remains a distinct import even when it shares the same Blob. The client does not add automatic retries or content deduplication
Project trash must use the authority port's atomic trash-if-unreferenced operation; never split reference checking from lifecycle mutation in the SDK

Global lifecycle is at-least-once: trash retries one stable deleteOperationId and restore CASes the deleteOperationId observed from the trashed entry; a stale operation must never restore a newer trash
Client mutations accept ProjectAsset product facts only and never storage keys, paths, URLs or credentials

key_files.src/index.ts: Public ports, resolver and semantic client exports.
key_files.src/asset-client.ts: Validated ProjectAsset resolution, Action binding, reference, and lifecycle behavior.
key_files.src/global-asset-client.ts: Validated host-neutral Global library entry client and authority port, including consumer-side trash/restore CAS.
key_files.src/project-asset-http-client.ts: Shared browser/Node Project Asset HTTP transport returning only canonical ResolvedAsset values and opaque observations.
key_files.src/personal-global-asset-http-client.ts: Shared browser/Node personal Global library HTTP transport returning only canonical ResolvedAsset values.
key_files.src/asset-delivery.ts: Host-neutral signed URL issuance port for read and upload capabilities.
key_files.src/asset-delivery-capability.ts: Opaque HMAC capability token signer/verifier; claims never contain storage locators.
key_files.src/asset-delivery-store.ts: Host-neutral byte-store port used behind standalone delivery endpoints.
key_files.src/resource-replication.ts: Verified at-least-once Resource byte push/pull for local and hosted replicas.
key_files.src/delivery.ts: Narrow server-runtime entrypoint for delivery and replication ports.

architecture_notes: Resource bytes and projections are Host-owned ports. ProjectAssetEntry remains Project Loro authority and ResolvedAsset is read-only. Delivery is storage-neutral: R2, S3, filesystem, and other stores implement AssetDeliveryStore behind the standalone capability endpoint.
